description: This file implements a command for finding dependency paths between two targets in a build system, including path classification and printing, with options for different dependency types and path outputs.

classes.name: Options
classes.description: Configuration options for dependency path search, including output type and dependency filters.

classes.name: Stats
classes.description: Tracks statistics about found paths, including counts and classifications.

methods.name: ClassifyPath
methods.description: Determines the overall dependency type of a path based on its segments.

methods.name: StringForDepType
methods.description: Converts a DepType enum value to its string representation.

methods.name: PrintPath
methods.description: Outputs a formatted representation of a dependency path.

methods.name: InsertTargetsIntoFoundPaths
methods.description: Records targets involved in a path into the found paths statistics.

methods.name: BreadthFirstSearch
methods.description: Performs a BFS to find dependency paths between two targets, considering dependency types and printing options.

methods.name: DoSearch
methods.description: Runs BFS searches with different dependency filters based on options.

methods.name: RunPath
methods.description: Main function to parse arguments, set up environment, execute path search, and output results.
